summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release archive, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bun, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB bun-compiled bundle with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0xNNNN`) and a shuffled string-array rotation function (WV8StW) — heavy obfuscation with no relationship to the package's stated CircleCI orb purpose. Fetching an alternate runtime purely to execute a bundled opaque payload at install time is an alternate-runtime dropper: the payload runs with the installer's privileges on `npm install`, and using Bun instead of Node evades Node-based static and dynamic tooling. The package name `native-frontend-orb` also mirrors the repository slug `ornikar/orb-frontend-native` while being published outside the `@ornikar` scope, consistent with namespace impersonation of Ornikar's CircleCI orb tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
